  • International moves & info ops: Pakistan actively mediating. TASS claims drones that attacked Moscow were assembled with NATO cooperation — unverified; treat as possible propaganda to strain coalition unity.

  • 🟢 Good News: A formal pause window was announced and mediators engaged (Pakistan) — provides diplomatic opening if respected.

Situation Report — Day 27

  • Active strikes: US/Israeli airstrikes on Iran continue. Iran, Hezbollah and Hamas launch missile/rocket strikes into Israel.
  • Ceasefire pause status: Trump announced a SECOND pause on strikes against Iran (10 days; deadline Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET), citing an "Iranian Government request" and talks "going very well." Iran denies direct talks. First pause (Mar 23, 5 days) was violated within hours by strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr.
  • Mediation: Pakistan reported as mediator between the US and Iran.
  • Northern Border (Lebanon/Hezbollah): Daily Hezbollah activity. IDF reports recent operations: 17 terrorists killed, >100 arrests over past week. Small Israeli withdrawal agreed from two areas in Lebanon (step in de-escalation talks).
  • Air/Sea: Major regional airports reported closed (Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan). Iran allows transit through Strait of Hormuz only to selected "friendly" states (Russia, India, China); others face restrictions.
  • US-Iran exchanges: Iran claims strikes on US-linked targets and announces strikes against US forces in the Middle East. US strikes reported in response to a drone attack on a commercial ship.
  • Domestic security: Israeli forces conducting searches after reported infiltrations; public anxiety remains high (polling shows large share fear repeat of Oct 7–style attack).
  • International military posture: European debates continue; Germany/Europe conducting troop reviews amid NATO friction over the Iran campaign.
  • Tactical context:
    • Second pause is political, not verified on the ground. First pause was broken within hours — sets precedent for low trust.
    • Selective Hormuz passage is a new lever Iran is using to reward allies and pressure others.
  • 🟢 Good News: Pakistan mediation is active. Israel and Lebanon reached a limited withdrawal agreement. IDF reports successful counter-operations (17 enemy fighters killed, >100 detained).
  • Threat assessment: Escalating.

  • Domestic Public anxiety high; polls show large share of Israelis expect a repeat major attack.

Threat assessment: Escalating.

  • מיצר הורמוז: איראן מאפשרת מעבר לספינות רוסיה, הודו וסין וחוסמת אחרות. משמעות טקטית: מסלולים בטוחים סלקטיביים וסיכון לחופש המסחר.
